title: Thousand Needles
body: Thousand Needles is a deep canyon below the cliffs at the southern edge of the Barrens, named for the tall columns of sandstone that rise from its dry floor. Tauren make their homes on the high mesas, out of reach of the centaur war bands below, climbing to them by lifts and crossing between the spires on rope bridges. The Galak centaur raid the canyon roads, a band of the Grimtotem keeps its secrets on Darkcloud Pinnacle, and in the east lie the Shimmering Flats, a blinding salt plain where gnomes and goblins race rocket cars.

title: Freewind Post
body: Freewind Post is the Horde's stronghold in Thousand Needles, a tauren village high atop a mesa, reached by wooden lifts and joined to the neighboring pinnacles by rope bridges. Cliffwatcher Longhorn directs its defense against centaur raids, harpies and the Grimtotem of Darkcloud Pinnacle, whose secret visitors trouble him. North of the post, in a hidden cave above the canyon, the sage Dorn Plainstalker tests the young of every tribe in spirit, body and mind.

parts.body: A sin'dorei has made her home on a windswept butte here: Magistrix Elosai, cast out by her own people, who burned every copy of her treatise on a natural cure for their addiction to magic.
Her tonic did not cure her. It hastened her descent toward the Wretched, and she wonders whether her people must simply learn to live with their hunger.

title: Darkcloud Pinnacle
body: East of the Great Lift, three small mesas joined by rope bridges form Darkcloud Pinnacle, home of a band of the Grimtotem tribe, and the only two ways in are well guarded. The clan keeps secrets here: three agents of unknown origin have visited it, and their messages lie locked in chests. On an isolated needle where the tribe lays its dead rests the dormant Sacred Fire of Life.

parts.body: Lit, the Sacred Fire calls forth Arikara, a serpent of tauren legend born only to seek vengeance against those who have committed heinous acts.

title: Splithoof Crag
body: Splithoof Crag is the chief village of the Galak centaur, set against the northern wall of the canyon north of Freewind Post, and their warriors also ride from Camp E'thok in the northwest to strike at caravans on the road. In a heavily guarded cavern at the heart of the crag, the tribe keeps its greatest treasure: the Cloven Hoof, a relic from the time of the centaurs' creation, held within an eternal flame.

parts.body: The flame can be breached for a little while with water from a night elf moonwell, for the dryads and the centaur share a common ancestry.

title: The Shimmering Flats
body: At the eastern end of the canyon lie the Shimmering Flats, a dried lakebed of blinding salt below the level of the sea. Wrecked rocket cars from the Mirage Raceway litter it, and the half-buried Tahonda Ruins were a tauren village abandoned long ago for reasons no one knows. In the southwest the Explorers' League dug at the Rustmaul site until a Horde war party fell upon it, and what came out of the earth after them still crawls there.

title: Mirage Raceway
body: Out on the Shimmering Flats lies the Mirage Raceway, where gnomes and goblins race rocket cars to settle whose engineering is better, with a dwarf race master taking the wagers. The gnome brothers Brassbolts build a car so fast its pilots keep crashing; the goblin team's builder Pozzik, once among the most respected tinkerers in Undermine, is on his eighteenth pilot. The dwarf Kravel Koalbeard buys the wreckage, sure there is always profit in someone else's tragedy.

parts.body: The gnomes' sudden speed has a secret: indurium, an ore from the dwarven dig at Uldaman that shrugs off heat.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Mirage_Raceway (gnomes and goblins competing with rocket cars; Kronkrider a dwarf)

parts.body: Kravel has a scheme with Booty Bay: dull the wits of one pit crew, let its car fall into disrepair before a race, and bet on a result he has already decided.
